name: review-score
title: Review score
description: A review score in a box with a word: 8.9 Excellent and the review count, the compact rating for listings, named in full for screen readers.
docs: The whole is named "Rated 8.9 out of 10, Excellent, 1,204 reviews". The word comes from bands you can set with labels, and the fill of the box (solid, outlined, quiet) repeats it, so strength never depends on colour. A score without reviews says "No reviews yet". href makes it a link.
